title: orders.payment.completed
description: A payment for an order completed, as reported by the PAYMENT provider registered in stapel-orders (the built-in mock, or a host's provider). The stapel-orders consumer marks the order paid on it (amount and currency must equal the order's, otherwise needs_review). Not stapel-billing's payment.completed: that fact is owned by billing, has billing's shape, and orders only reads it. user_id is null for a guest account. simulated is true when no money moved (PAYMENT='mock'); a consumer that counts revenue or writes to the payer must skip it. Key = order id. Since 0.2.0.
